tickets.title: Collect estate planning documents
tickets.text: Obtain the full policy contract, claim packet, and elimination-period instructions from Amber Teapot Life Insurance for Martin Cloudpuddle’s long-term care claim. The premium notice is in the file but the complete claim documentation is needed.
tickets.evidence: Helena had the premium notice but not the full policy contract, claim packet, or elimination-period instructions requested by Amber Teapot Life Insurance; those materials are needed by 2024-01-10.

tickets.title: Reconcile Pocket Lantern Home Care invoice discrepancy
tickets.text: Reconcile the Pocket Lantern Home Care billed aide hours for the first service week with Helena’s calendar and aide sign-in sheet. Resolve the difference before using the invoice amount for planning assumptions.
tickets.evidence: Pocket Lantern Home Care’s portal shows more billed aide hours for the first service week than Helena’s calendar and aide sign-in sheet, so the home-care invoice amount is not ready for planning assumptions;

tickets.title: Prepare care-cost runway projection
tickets.text: Prepare a care-cost runway projection comparing the current 32-hour-per-week aide schedule at $38 per hour with a higher-coverage scenario, showing when cash reserves would require increased taxable-account withdrawals for Martin Cloudpuddle’s ongoing care.
tickets.evidence: Helena asked for a care-cost runway projection comparing the current aide schedule with a higher-coverage scenario and showing when cash reserves would require an increased taxable-account withdrawal; the agreed follow-up is due 2024-01-05.

tickets.title: Document family caregiver reimbursement approach
tickets.text: Create a documented family caregiver reimbursement approach for Lila Cloudpuddle’s weekday transportation and medication supervision, ensuring the arrangement does not blur gifts, wages, and shared household costs.
tickets.evidence: Lila is reducing her clinic hours to cover weekday transportation and medication supervision, and Helena wants a documented family caregiver reimbursement approach that does not blur gifts, wages, and shared household costs; the agreed follow-up is due 2024-01-12.

tickets.title: Prepare financial questions for rehab care conference
tickets.text: Prepare financial questions and affordability figures for the rehab team’s near-term care conference to review home therapy authorization and daily supervision for Martin Cloudpuddle.
tickets.evidence: The rehab team set a near-term care conference to review home therapy authorization and daily supervision, and Helena wants financial questions and affordability figures ready for that conversation; the agreed follow-up is due 2024-01-08.
